header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [LEAFFIX v0.1.5]
header.description: v0.1.5 LEAFFIX — fixes v0.1.4 black halos on grass/fern (alpha dilation now fills newly-opaque pixels with average RGB of opaque neighbors instead of exposing the hidden black/white PNG background). Isotropic rotation added for 8 leaves blocks to break up aligned-slab interior canopies.
